title: GameNavigationGuard
responsibility: Protect unsaved game edits during app navigation, browser unload and native window lifecycle decisions.

inputs.name: GameNavigationGuard.active
inputs.description: True while the authoring document has unsaved changes; enables confirmation before leaving.

outputs.name: GameNavigationGuard
outputs.description: Renders no visible markup. Registers a navigation guard that confirms in-app navigation and requests host unload prevention.
